process.title: From your ticket to your decision
process.description: Your ticket, authorization, evidence and updates stay connected to the same file.

intake.title: Share your ticket
intake.body: Upload a readable ticket and provide your details. Fabsy reviews eligibility and deadlines; service starts after intake, authorization, payment and acceptance.

disclosure.title: Disclosure is requested
disclosure.body: Where authorized and available, Fabsy requests the prosecution's evidence and tracks documents. A request does not extend any deadline.

review.title: Evidence is reviewed
review.body: Technology-assisted analysis and qualified review examine the evidence, procedure and available pre-trial options.

action.title: The next step is prepared
action.body: Within 48 hours of complete, readable disclosure being received and matched to the file, Fabsy reviews it and prepares or submits the next authorized prosecutor step.

decision.title: You give the instruction
decision.body: Fabsy explains any Crown response. Only you direct whether an available resolution should be accepted; trial work requires a separate agreement.

fee.question: What does the {{price}} fee cover?
fee.answer: Eligible pre-trial intake, deadline review, authorization, disclosure requests and tracking, qualified review, a fact-specific prosecutor-review submission, file updates and explanation of a Crown response. Applicable GST is extra; fines and trial work are separate.

speed.question: Will my ticket be resolved in 48 hours?
speed.answer: No final-outcome timing is promised. The 48-hour commitment begins only when complete, readable disclosure arrives and is matched to your file. It covers Fabsy's review and next authorized action, not the prosecutor's response time.

deadline.question: Does a disclosure request extend my deadline?
deadline.answer: No. Continue monitoring the dates on your ticket, court notice and portal. A disclosure request does not itself extend a response date, trial date or other deadline.

trial.question: Is a trial included?
trial.answer: No. Trial representation requires separate eligibility review, an agreement and a quote. Appeals, reopenings, government charges and out-of-scope work are also separate.

approval.question: Can Fabsy accept an offer for me?
approval.answer: Only after your case-specific instruction. Fabsy will not accept a Crown offer, enter a guilty plea or finalize a proposed resolution automatically.

outcome.question: Is a withdrawal or reduction promised?
outcome.answer: No. The result depends on the charge, evidence, procedure, prosecutor and court. There is no promise of a withdrawal, reduction, lower fine, fewer demerits or insurance result.

language.question: Can I write in my language?

consent.title: Digital authorization for Rapid Resolution
consent.scope: I authorize Fabsy and its agents, where permitted, to request, receive and review disclosure; use the Traffic Tickets Digital Service; communicate with the court, prosecutor and relevant government offices; prepare and submit a fact-specific prosecutor-review request based on my instructions and record; and explain any Crown response, charge, fine and demerit consequences.
consent.approval: Fabsy may take a final resolution step only after my express case-specific instruction. This authorization does not permit automatic acceptance of a Crown offer or a guilty plea.
consent.exclusions: Contested trials, appeals, reopenings, Immediate Roadside Sanctions and Notices of Administrative Penalty are excluded. Trial work requires a separate agreement and fee. A prescribed Government of Alberta consent form may also be required.
consent.fee: I voluntarily retain Fabsy for the limited pre-trial service at {{price}} CAD plus applicable GST. Government fines and excluded work are separate. I understand the scope, the 48-hour condition and that no result is promised.
consent.data: I consent to collection and processing of my information to deliver the service, technology-assisted document extraction and analysis with qualified review, secure record storage, communications about my case by email, phone and text and necessary sharing with courts and authorities. I will provide accurate, complete information. I may request access or withdraw data consent by contacting privacy@fabsy.ca.
consent.withdrawal: I may withdraw this authorization by written notice. Otherwise it remains valid until the matter is resolved or withdrawn. Withdrawal does not automatically cancel fees for work already performed.
consent.confirm: I am the person named above and am authorized to enter this agreement. I have read and understood this authorization and agree to the limited service. My digital signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: This page translates selected terms for Rapid Resolution and the insurance planning report. The complete Terms of Service, including the Photo Radar, Pro Driver Discount and Refer a Driver terms in sections 5C–5E, are available in English. Read them before authorizing or purchasing a service.
terms.englishControls: The English Terms of Service control if a translation differs. Statutory rights are not limited. Ask for clarification before consenting if you do not understand a term.

service.title: 1. Service description
service.body: Fabsy Traffic Ticket Services is an Alberta traffic ticket agent service, not a law firm. Paid services are Rapid Resolution for eligible pre-trial matters and the Insurance Impact & Renewal Planning Report. Work may include secure intake, eligibility and deadline review, digital authorization, disclosure requests and tracking, technology-assisted analysis with qualified review, authorized fact-specific prosecutor-review submissions, file notifications, Crown-response explanations and client-directed decisions. Optional reports use client records and approved public sources. Contested trials, appeals, reopenings, Immediate Roadside Sanctions, Notices of Administrative Penalty, government fines and work outside the permitted scope are excluded from Rapid Resolution.

practice.title: 2. Limits on agent practice
practice.body: Fabsy representatives do not provide legal advice or practise law, identify themselves as lawyers or Fabsy as a law firm, accept matters outside the permitted agent scope, or promise particular results.

eligibility.title: 3. Service availability
eligibility.body: Availability depends on the charge, procedure, deadline, court location, portal requirements and whether paid agent services are permitted and accepted by Fabsy. Matters outside the scope may be declined or referred elsewhere.

pricing.title: 4. Pricing
pricing.body: Rapid Resolution costs {{price}} CAD plus applicable GST for eligible Alberta pre-trial matters. The standalone Insurance Impact & Renewal Planning Report costs {{reportPrice}} CAD plus applicable GST. Both together cost {{bundlePrice}} CAD plus applicable GST. Trial representation, government fines and out-of-scope matters are separate.

payment.title: 5. Fees and payment
payment.body: All fees are in Canadian dollars. Court costs, fines and other charges beyond Fabsy's control remain your responsibility. The complete subtotal and tax are displayed before payment through Stripe.

rapid.title: 5A. Rapid Resolution
rapid.body: Service starts only after intake, authorization and payment are complete and Fabsy accepts the matter. Where authorized and operationally available, Fabsy requests and reviews disclosure. A disclosure request does not extend a response date, trial date or other deadline. You must monitor every deadline and attend personally if required. The 48-hour commitment begins only when complete, readable disclosure is received and matched to your file; it covers Fabsy's review and preparation or submission of the next authorized action, not Crown response time or final-outcome timing. Fabsy will not accept a Crown offer, enter a guilty plea or finalize a resolution without your case-specific instruction. Trial work requires separate eligibility review, an agreement and a quote.

report.title: 5B. Insurance planning report
report.body: This is a one-time consumer research and planning product. Driver abstracts, broker services, insurer quotes and other third-party records cost extra. You must provide accurate ticket, driving-record, policy, renewal and rating information. Scenarios and ranges use approved public information and supplied records; they are not insurer quotes. Sources and questions are planning aids, not recommendations to buy, cancel, renew or change coverage. Fabsy is not an insurance agent or broker and does not sell, quote or place insurance, contact insurers, submit applications or negotiate renewals. No eligibility, savings or premium result is promised. Insurer-specific advice and quotes must come from a licensed broker or insurer.

responsibilities.title: 6. Your responsibilities
responsibilities.body: Provide accurate and complete ticket information, respond promptly to requests, review every Crown response and give clear instructions before an offer expires, attend court if required, and pay applicable fees and court costs. Fabsy provides agent representation services, not legal advice.

outcomes.title: 7. No promised result
outcomes.body: Results depend on the charge, evidence, procedure, prosecutor and court. No withdrawal, charge reduction, lower fine, fewer demerits, premium savings, insurer eligibility or other result is promised. The 48-hour commitment is not a promise of an outcome.

privacy.title: 8. Confidentiality
privacy.body: Fabsy protects client information through internal privacy practices and applicable privacy obligations. Information may be disclosed as needed for court proceedings or as required by law.

liability.title: 9. Limitation of liability
liability.body: Fabsy's liability is limited to the service fees paid. Fabsy is not liable for indirect, consequential or punitive damages arising from its representation services.

cancellation.title: 10. Cancellation, refunds and termination
cancellation.body: Either party may terminate by mutual agreement, for non-payment, failure to provide information or cooperation, or if representation becomes impossible or impractical. Contact Fabsy promptly to request cancellation. Refund eligibility depends on work already performed, third-party charges, checkout disclosures and applicable law. If Fabsy declines an otherwise complete paid matter before substantive work begins, the applicable service fee will be refunded. Statutory cancellation rights are not limited.

website.title: 11. Website use
website.body: Using the website constitutes acceptance of the terms. Do not use it unlawfully, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with functionality or transmit harmful or malicious code.

law.title: 12. Governing law
law.body: The terms are governed by the laws of Alberta, Canada. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Alberta courts.

changes.title: 13. Changes to terms
changes.body: Fabsy may modify the terms. Changes are posted on the English terms page with an updated revision date. Continued use of services after changes constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

contact.title: 14. Contact
contact.body: For questions, contact Fabsy Traffic Ticket Services at {{email}} or (825) 793-2279. Service area: Alberta.
